nodes.text: A green clothbound ledger. Columns ruled by hand: TITLE · FORM · STATUS · NOTES. The entries are in at least three pens.

IRIS · game · our initial offering · in production.
LAND OF MILK & HONEY · game, three players · in development · keep it three.
PHILADELPHIA · game · shelved.

A line inked out, all four columns.
RETINAL BURN · game · GDD only.
PANTHEON · game · hold, peripheral.
CRECHE · game · see 0.

STATURO · world bible · for later.
HARBINGER · cards · four decks, five boxes.
KOMODO DAWN · film, w/ L.A. Steve · turnaround.
THE TIMBER GRANDE · not ours · licensing: ask J.D. Under it, a later pen: asked. no answer.
SCUMM · cabinet, one unit · placed on loan, Pizza Pirate, Cypress St. · do not invoice.
ROFLCOPTR · strip, A. Finch, Small Wood High, '97 · option lapsed. Beside it: renew?
SLOW STICKS · R&D · no budget · you put it in and wait. The note in the last column is a citation: N.D., dream journal, spring '94.
At the foot of the page, the brass. D. Dean. Two names blacked out. The attorney, whose initials are at the bottom of every page.
The last ruled page has dates down the left margin and nothing beside them. The dates start at 2050.
